purpose: High-value anatomical reference plates for the Wooden Armature Bible.
status: source-url manifest; image binaries pending local import

accept: images with clear source, author, title, and section address
reject: modern copyrighted textbook scans without rights path
decorative images with no technical role

plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon and proportion plates; Part I System Overview; opening anatomical lineage plate
plates.caption: Vesalius, De humani corporis fabrica, page 163: full-length frontal skeleton leaning on a shovel. Use as an inspirational full-body skeleton plate showing anatomy as staged presence rather than inert diagram.
plates.technical_use: Full-body proportion, axial stance, skeletal silhouette, historical anatomy-as-presence reference.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Highly inspirational and section-relevant. Not a modern measurement baseline; pair with Albinus and Cheselden for more technical proportion checks.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies public-domain historical source target; final rights note should be confirmed during image hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon and proportion plates; axial posture comparison
plates.caption: Vesalius, page 164: full-length side skeleton contemplating a skull. Use for side-view posture, axial curve, and historical body-theatre reference.
plates.technical_use: Side silhouette, spine curvature, head/pelvis balance, full-body attitude.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Strong side-reference companion to Vesalius page 163. Use as inspirational and proportional cross-check, not fabrication drawing.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon and proportion plates; posterior full-body reference
plates.caption: Vesalius, page 165: posterior skeleton leaning on the hands. Use as a dramatic posterior skeletal reference and early evidence of skeleton-as-posed-body.
plates.technical_use: Posterior silhouette, shoulder/pelvis relation, spine and scapular presence.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Excellent historical posterior plate; not a modern orthographic reference.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.source_family: Albinus / Wandelaar / Tabulae sceleti et musculorum
plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon and proportion plates; G4.7 Pelvic bowl; G4.8 Shoulder girdle
plates.caption: Albinus and Wandelaar, Table 1: full-length frontal skeleton. Use as a clean idealized standing proportion plate for the complete armature.
plates.technical_use: Frontal skeleton proportions, shoulder width, pelvic attitude, limb axis checks.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. High technical value for full-body proportional oath; more formal and measured than Vesalius.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.source_family: Albinus / Wandelaar / Tabulae sceleti et musculorum
plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon; G4.8 Shoulder girdle; posterior structural check
plates.caption: Albinus and Wandelaar, Table 2: full-length posterior skeleton. Use for posterior scapula, pelvis, spine, and long-limb balance checks.
plates.technical_use: Posterior shoulder girdle, spine/pelvis relation, lower limb verticality.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Critical posterior complement to Table 1.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.source_family: Albinus / Wandelaar / Tabulae sceleti et musculorum
plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon; axial posture; side silhouette
plates.caption: Albinus and Wandelaar, Table 3: full-length left-side skeleton. Use for side-view posture, spine curvature, and skull-pelvis-foot balance.
plates.technical_use: Side proportion, sagittal alignment, foot/stance reference.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.6 Axial core; G4.7 Pelvic bowl; G4.8 Shoulder girdle
plates.caption: Cheselden, Osteographia, Plate 19: anterior trunk skeleton including rib cage, vertebral column, and pelvis. Use for axial-core, rib, sternum, pelvis, and shoulder-girdle layout.
plates.technical_use: Anterior rib cage, sternum, pelvis, vertebral column, shoulder relation.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. High-value regional plate for translating torso anatomy into armature assemblies.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.6 Axial core; posterior rib/spine/pelvis reference
plates.caption: Cheselden, Plate 20: posterior trunk skeleton including rib cage, vertebral column, and pelvis. Use for posterior axial-core and scapular planning.
plates.technical_use: Posterior spine, ribs, pelvis, scapular context.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Necessary paired posterior plate for Plate 19.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.10 Hands; phalanx templates; miniature joint design
plates.caption: Cheselden, Plate 25a: hand bones, internal and external views. Use as a bone-first reference for carpals, metacarpals, phalanges, and miniature component segmentation.
plates.technical_use: Hand bone proportions, palm/finger relation, phalanx and metacarpal separation.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Critical for avoiding mannequin-hand simplification.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.12 Feet; stance and base-contact architecture
plates.caption: Cheselden, Plate 29: foot bones from above, below, and side. Use as the primary osteological reference for foot assemblies, arches, toe segmentation, and contact logic.
plates.technical_use: Foot arch, tarsals, metatarsals, toes, ground-contact geometry.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Essential for foot component design.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon; proportion audit; female armature reference
plates.caption: Cheselden, Plate 34: standing female skeleton. Use as a historical full-body female skeletal proportion reference for the armature's visible body plan.
plates.technical_use: Female skeletal proportion, pelvis, stance, rib/shoulder/hip relation.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. High priority because PHY is targeting elegant adult female proportions; must be paired with modern references later.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.

plates.manual_section: G4.5 Full-body canon; comparative skeletal proportion
plates.caption: Cheselden, Plate 35: standing male skeleton. Use as a comparative proportion reference against the female skeleton plate and other full-body canons.
plates.technical_use: Comparative skeletal proportion, shoulder/pelvis differences, stance.
plates.inspection_notes: KEEP. Useful comparator, not primary target body plan.
plates.rights_note: NLM Historical Anatomies source target; confirm rights during hardening.
